full_text:
Job Title: Data Entry Executive
Company: ABC Technologies Pvt. Ltd.
Location: Hyderabad, India (Remote/Hybrid Available)
Job Type: Full-Time

About the Company:
ABC Technologies Pvt. Ltd. is a growing IT services company specializing in data management and business process solutions. We are committed to maintaining high standards of accuracy, integrity, and client satisfaction.

Job Description:
We are seeking a detail-oriented and reliable Data Entry Executive to join our team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for entering, updating, and maintaining accurate data in our systems.

Key Responsibilities:

Accurately input and update data into company databases
Verify data for errors and correct inconsistencies
Maintain confidentiality of sensitive information
Generate reports as required
Meet daily and weekly productivity targets

Requirements:

Minimum qualification: Intermediate / Bachelor’s degree preferred
Basic computer skills (MS Excel, MS Word)
Good typing speed and attention to detail
Strong organizational and time management skills
Ability to work independently and as part of a team

Salary & Benefits:

₹15,000 – ₹25,000 per month (based on experience)
Provident Fund (PF) and Employee State Insurance (ESI)
Paid leave and holidays
Opportunities for career growth and skill development

Application Process:
Interested candidates can apply by sending their updated resume to: hr@abctech.com

Shortlisted candidates will be contacted for an interview (online or in-office).

Equal Opportunity Statement:
ABC Technologies Pvt. Ltd. is an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive work environment.
